build_quadratic_baseline: build a QuadraticBaseline instance with an env_spec and optional input dimension for RL baseline fitting
fit_quadratic_baseline: fit the QuadraticBaseline to trajectory paths using regularized least squares regression on quadratic features
predict_baseline_returns: predict baseline returns for a single trajectory path using the fitted QuadraticBaseline coefficients
extract_quadratic_features: extract linear, quadratic, and time polynomial features from trajectory paths for baseline regression
review_quadratic_baseline_fit: review the QuadraticBaseline fit method to understand regularization and error return behavior
